transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Well... I guess my head just feels cloudy lately. I'll sit there and stare at a board packet, or... an email from a vendor, and I just can't seem to decide on even the simple things. Things I used to handle fast. So... that's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself worrying a lot, even about everyday things?
No... not really. I mean, just the normal things, I guess. I wouldn't say I worry a lot.
Have you been feeling down or depressed lately?
No... I wouldn't say depressed. I don't really get like that. Just... having trouble getting through my work, like I said.
Did this start after something particularly stressful happened in your life?

Well... I suppose it started about two weeks ago. My husband just retired, so he's... home all day now. It's been an adjustment. I guess that's when I noticed the shift... feeling more energetic and confident at first, and then just... this cloudy feeling settling in.
Around the time this started, did you need less sleep than usual?
I don't... I didn't really notice anything like that. I guess my sleep was just normal. I don't really keep track.
Have you been more forgetful than usual lately?

I don't know about forgetful. It's more just... my head feels cloudy. I'll sit there and stare at a board packet, or... a vendor email. And I just can't decide. Even simple things that I used to handle fast... I just kind of get stuck.
Have you been having trouble concentrating?
I guess so. Like I was just saying... it's just that cloudy feeling. I sit there staring at the papers and I can't... I just can't focus enough to make a choice.
Has this cloudy feeling started to interfere with your work?

I mean... I'm still going in. But... I guess I've had to slow down. I've been having my assistant double-check all the vendor details before I approve anything. And... I put off a couple of items for the board. I just... I don't really trust my judgment right now.
Did you start any new medication around the time this cloudy feeling began?
No... I haven't started anything new. Just the usual.
Have you been misplacing things more often than usual?
No... I don't think so. I haven't really noticed losing anything. Everything is pretty much where I leave it.
Have you had any recent illness or injury to your head?
No... no illnesses. And I haven't hit my head or anything.
Do there come times when you feel unusually drowsy or less alert than normal?
Not really... I mean, I feel fine during the day. Just normal tired at night, I guess... but nothing unusual.
Have other people noticed that your memory is worse than it used to be?
No... nobody's said anything to me.
Have you been enjoying your usual activities less than you normally do?

I guess so... I just haven't really wanted to go to my dance class lately. Or look at the little galleries... things like that. I haven't even been cooking the Sunday food for my family. 

Just haven't felt like it. Usually, doing those things makes me feel like myself, but... I don't know.
Have you noticed any change in your appetite lately?

I suppose... my eating has been a little off. I mostly just have coffee and a few bites of something... that carries me through most of the day. And then at night, I don't know... I just pick at some tortillas or sweets. Not really enjoying it, just... picking.
Have you felt slowed down lately, like your movements or thinking are moving more slowly than usual?

I guess it depends. At home... yeah, I move slow. My legs just feel heavy. But then... when I'm running meetings for the properties, it's different. I can't really sit still. I catch myself tapping my pen, or... shifting around in the chair a lot. Just feeling too keyed up, I suppose.
Have you been feeling worthless or excessively guilty lately?

I don't know... I suppose I've been feeling a bit guilty about work. I just... I keep thinking I let the residents down. I tend to speak too big, you know? Promising things to them before I actually check the money we have for the properties. Nobody has actually said I ruined anything, but... I just feel like I did.
Have you had thoughts that life isn’t worth living, or thoughts of wanting to hurt yourself?

I don't know... I mean, I don't want to hurt myself. I don't have any sort of plan to do anything like that. But... well, a few mornings recently, I just had this... scary thought. Just a passing thought that maybe it would be easier if I just didn't wake up. But I wouldn't do anything.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the day?
I don't think so. I wouldn't really say I feel sad. Just... I don't know. I'm just getting by, I guess.
Have you found that things that would normally make you feel happy or warm just don’t reach you emotionally lately?

I suppose... yes. I just haven't had the energy for much. Usually, I'd go to my dance class, or maybe walk around and look at the little galleries... but I haven't wanted to do any of that. I haven't even felt like cooking Sunday dinner for the family. Those things usually make me feel more like myself, but... lately, I just don't care to do them.
